name: pcln_fuel_synth_grid
description: Virtual fuel bed: METL/PUMP frame around a grid of PCLN(PLUT) cells on 2px pitch and a PRTI export floor. Empty until the PCLN row is powered, then it manufactures the whole PLUT charge; cut power to end a meltdown.
why: Save 254630 (Nuclear Power Plant 2) has 0 PLUT/DEUT/NEUT particles at rest; the charge is synthesised by 52 PCLN(PLUT) at x=249..267 step 2, y=277..285 step 2, PCLN(NEUT) at (257-259,267), and drained through PRTI ch5 rows at y=287/289. Source PCLN(PLUT) sit at -80C; kept here. The NEUT trio is left out so the grid does not self-ignite the moment it is powered -- add neut_seed_pod or neut_cray_nozzle to trigger. PRTI floor is a continuous row here (source used 2px pitch) so one channel = one portal region. The two PUMP columns are embedded in the METL frame exactly as in the source; blueprint_lint flags them as unwalled (pump_vacu_no_wall) -- accepted, they pressurise the grid interior, not open air.
